data.name: Susi
data.gender_notes: Susi is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Susanna, meaning ‘graceful’ or ‘highly favored.’ In the biblical book of Daniel, Susanna is a beautiful and virtuous woman who is falsely accused of adultery. The name Susi carries the meaning “Graceful, Loved One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Susi usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, loved one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of grace, purity, and innocence.
data.etymology: Susi belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Loved One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Susi total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.long_meaning: סוסי הוא שם עברי שמקורו בשם החייתי 'סוס', ויכול להתפרש כחיים או שושנים פורחות לנצח. השם עשוי להיות קשור לנושא של שושנים ופריחה, המייצגים חיים וברכה.

in_greek.name: Σούσι
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Σούσι μπορεί να συνδεθεί με την έννοια της ανάστασης και της ζωής. Στην παράδοση των ονομάτων, το Σούσι μπορεί να συμβολίζει την πνευματική ανάσταση και την αιώνια ζωή μέσω της πίστης.

in_latin.name: Susi
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Susi derivatum est ex hebraeo, quod significat ' vita' seu 'floridus'. In traditione christiana, Susi potest significare vitam aeternam per Christum et resurrectionem spiritualem.

in_english.name: Susi
in_english.long_meaning: The name Susi originates from Hebrew roots, relating to 'horse' or 'flourishing'. In Christian tradition, Susi symbolizes eternal life, spiritual growth, and the resurrection through faith in Christ. Historically, the name may have been used to signify a life of spiritual flourishing and devotion.

It was a name that belonged to a biblical figure who, in the face of false accusations, remained steadfast in her innocence and faith. The name Susi embodies the cultural value of unwavering respect for virtue and truth, as well as the strength and resilience of the human spirit in overcoming adversity.
